simulator.name: mimo
simulator.description: Uplink MIMO link with 8 receive antennas. Choose transmit power (dBm) and the number of active transmit RF chains (1-8) to maximise energy efficiency in Mbit/J. Capacity grows with power and streams, but every active chain costs circuit power. Cheap fidelities are noisy Monte-Carlo estimates (unbiased); the metric 'stderr' reports their uncertainty.

params.name: n_tx
params.description: number of active transmit RF chains / streams

fidelities.name: mc4096
fidelities.notes: 4096 draws; standard error ~1% of the cheap estimate's
